title: (Deprecated) Get available post-bid third-party measurement partners
content_data:
Use this endpoint to get available post-bid third-party measurement partners, and the reason why you cannot choose a certain partner. ## Request **Endpoint** **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| |Content-Type {Required}|string| Request message type
Allowed format:`application/json`| ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {Required}|string| Advertiser ID | |objective_type {Required}|string| Your objective type. For enum values and descriptions, see [Objectives](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737585562434561).| | region_codes|string[]| List of country or region codes. For example: `["US", "JP", "KR"]`.

See [Appendix - Location code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737585867307010) for enum values.| |brand_safety_type|string|Brand safety type. The allowed enum values:
  • `STANDARD_INVENTORY`: Use TikTok's brand safety solution. Standard inventory means that ads will appear next to content that is appropriate for most brands.
  • `LIMITED_INVENTORY`: Use TikTok's brand safety solution. Limited inventory means that your ads will not appear next to content that contains mature themes.
To get the countries and regions that your ads can be deployed to based on your brand safety settings, use the [/tool/region/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737189539571713) endpoint.| ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|The response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string|The response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id|string| The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request.| |data |object|Returned data. | #| option_list | object[] | The list of post-bid third-party measurement partners. | ##| partner | string | Post-bid third-party brand safety or viewability measurement partner. Enum values: `MOAT`, `DOUBLE_VERIFY`, `IAS`, `ZEFR`.
You can set post-bid third-party measurement partners at the ad level via `viewability_postbid_partner` and `brand_safety_postbid_partner` when calling [/ad/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739953377508354). | ##| partner_name | string | Name of the post-bid third-party brand safety or viewability measurement partner. | ##| vast_type | string | The type of post-bid third-party measurement that the partner offers. Enum values: `VIEWABILITY` (viewability measurement), `BRAND_SAFETY` (brand safety measurement). | ##| is_require_url | boolean | Whether you need to provide a VAST URL when you choose the post-bid third-party measurement partner. | ##| is_available | boolean | Whether you can choose the post-bid third-party measurement partner when creating or updating ads. | ##| unavailable_reason | object[] | The information about why you cannot select the post-bid third-party measurement partner. Returned when `is_available` = `False`. | ###| reason | string | The reason why you cannot choose the post-bid third-party measurement partner. | ###| reason_type | string | The reason type. Enum values:
  • `UNSUPPORTED_PARTNER`: You are not authorized to choose this partner.
  • `UNSUPPORTED_OBJ_TYPE`: The partner is not supported for the specified advertising objective.
  • `UNSUPPORTED_COUNTRY`: The partner is not supported for one or more of the specified country or region codes.
  • `UNSUPPORTED_PREBID`: The partner is not supported for post-bid third-party measurement because of your pre-bid brand safety setting via `brand_safety_type` in the request.
| ```
seo_title: Get available TikTok post-bid third-party measurement via API
seo_description: Use this endpoint to get available post-bid third-party measurement partners, and the reason why you cannot choose a certain partner.
